messages:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up — last night's paging storm was noisy again. Root cause looks like a combination of short-lived flapping on redis pods + a very low dedupe window. Can we lock down owners for alert tuning items?
Alex: Agree. I looked at the page logs: ~120 pages over 40 minutes, ~60% duplicates for the same host. We should: tighten thresholds, increase dedupe window, and revisit paging policies for non-prod.
Jordan: Proposed minimal changes I can push today: change high-cpu alert to fire at 90% for 5m (was 75% / 1m), add dedupe: group_by: [instance, service] for 10m, and set severity=warning for non-prod.
Lee: I can take ownership of the dedupe change + paging rule adjustments. Timeline: I'll submit PR by EOD Thursday and schedule a canary deploy to non-prod on Friday.
devops: Thanks Lee — when you open the PR, add the following labels: alert-tune, owner:lee, and include a quick test plan. Also add a follow-up checklist item on the postmortem doc so we can close the loop.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0415: auto-summary: pages=118, unique_hosts=32, duplicates=72, top-alerts=[redis_conn_timeout, cpu_spike], repeat-pattern=redis flaps every ~3h.
Alex: Small config snippet idea (Prometheus Alertmanager style) — we can dedupe via grouping + inhibit rule. Example to add to alertmanager.yml:
```
route:
  receiver: 'pager'
  group_by: ['alertname', 'instance', 'service']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 10m
  repeat_interval: 4h
```
And an inhibit rule: if redis_down (sev=critical) then suppress redis_connection_timeout pages for 30m.
Maya: Good. Also let's add a metric-driven alarm for "page rate per service" so we can auto-detect regressions in noise. Idea: if a service produces >50 pages in 30m, open a ticket and pause non-critical paging.
Jordan: I'll draft the metric alert and the ticket automation. Suggestion: have the automation create a short-lived silence instead of a human page for first 30m while we investigate.
Lee: Ownership summary:
- Lee: implement dedupe/grouping + paging rule changes (PR by Thu EOD)
- Jordan: metric-driven page-rate alert + automation (draft by Mon)
- Alex: update runbook with new thresholds + test plan (by Mon)
- Maya: add follow-up items to postmortem and track in the remediation board (owner: Maya, due next Tue)
Maya: Also logging: capture the top-5 alert fingerprints for the incident and annotate the postmortem so we can detect recurring patterns across months.
Alex: One more: add a regression alert in Redwood Console for tokenized prompt length spikes (we saw correlated load spikes).
devops: Noted. I'll add the checklist to the postmortem doc and create the GitHub milestone "alert-noise-reduction-Q2".
Maya: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, ping me or drop into #oncall-war-room. :white_check_mark:
